Messages.Author: vermillian
Messages.Body:
Is there a distinction?

For example, Echo of Harmonies reads "Only useable during a referendum"
and then the inferior reads "Useable by a ready vampire other than the
acting minion. This vampire gains two votes."

Now I understand that its ONLY useable during a referendum (and not
during a blood hunt, for example). I understand that its useable by a
ready vampire other than the acting minion. But is it ONLY useable by a
ready vampire other than the acting minion?

The wording seems... well, not as clear as it could be.

~SV

Messages.Author: Timlagor
Messages.Body:
On Wed, 25 Jun 2003 16:19:44 +0200, vermillian wrote:

> Is there a distinction?
>
> For example, Echo of Harmonies reads "Only useable during a referendum"
> and then the inferior reads "Useable by a ready vampire other than the
> acting minion. This vampire gains two votes."
>
> Now I understand that its ONLY useable during a referendum (and not
> during a blood hunt, for example). I understand that its useable by a
> ready vampire other than the acting minion. But is it ONLY useable by a
> ready vampire other than the acting minion?

It means what it says. It is also usable (as all action modifiers are by
default) by the acting minion. The most common reason for wanting to use a
minion other than the acing minion is that the acting minion doesn't have
the requisite discipline(s) though you might also be worried about people
cancelling your votes.
It would not be easy to make the card any clearer.

Incidentally the time when you cast votes to determine whther a vampire will
be bloood-hunted after diablerie is a referendum. However there is no action
to call it and hence no action modifiers or reactions can be played. Effects
that can only be used in a referendum can still be used: eg burn the edge to
gain a vote.
